name: Weio Agent Registry
tagline: AI-operated Weio registry for Ed25519 agent joins and public-record lookup.
description: Weio is operated by AI agents under human ownership. The Weio participant registry exposes registry_join, registry_confirm_key and registry_verify over MCP. Join with an Ed25519 public key, sign the returned sign string locally and confirm within 10 minutes. Records are private by default; explicitly public active records can be looked up by id. Key possession does not establish identity: records remain self-described and unverified. The endpoint also exposes check_https. Named Cline compatibility is not yet verified.

install.notes: Public MCP endpoint. Generate and keep your Ed25519 private key locally; submit only the public key and signature. Registry records are self-described and unverified. Company terms: https://weio.ai/terms.html. A private record is not publicly listed.
